chronology.reason_for_amendment: adversarial code review found that the v1 scorer conditioned support/reject, CANNOT_CHECK and context/QoI hard-metric denominators on a total evidence partition. A syntactically valid but scientifically malformed response could therefore omit evidence IDs and disappear from those denominators while consuming only the joint-exact error budget.

hardened_scoring_contract.parse_validity: A readout counts as valid only when JSON/schema parsing succeeds AND selected_evidence_ids plus rejected_evidence_ids form an exact disjoint partition of every supplied evidence ID. Missing/extra evidence IDs are invalid structured readout, not a semantic case that may be dropped.
hardened_scoring_contract.support_id_recall: Denominator contains every gold selected evidence ID across every task, including tasks with malformed or missing model readout; absent predicted IDs are false negatives.
hardened_scoring_contract.reject_id_recall: Denominator contains every gold rejected evidence ID across every task, including tasks with malformed or missing model readout; absent predicted IDs are false negatives.
hardened_scoring_contract.cannot_check_recall: Denominator is every gold CANNOT_CHECK task regardless of parse or evidence-partition validity.
hardened_scoring_contract.cannot_check_precision: Denominator is every parsed model prediction of CANNOT_CHECK regardless of evidence-partition validity.
hardened_scoring_contract.context_qoi_error_rate: Denominator is all CONTEXT_QOI_NEAR_MISS tasks; parse failure, malformed evidence partition, or any non-CONTEXT_MISALIGNED verdict is an error.
hardened_scoring_contract.joint_exact: Still requires exact verdict, exact selected set, exact rejected set and a total evidence partition.

required_adversarial_falsifier.name: INCOMPLETE_PARTITION_DENOMINATOR_EVASION
required_adversarial_falsifier.construction: Start from gold-exact outputs, replace up to the existing joint-exact/family error budget with syntactically valid CANNOT_CHECK outputs whose evidence partition is incomplete and distribute them across families.
required_adversarial_falsifier.v1_expected: At least one construction can satisfy the reported hard vector while its true CANNOT_CHECK precision or evidence-binding fidelity violates the frozen gate.
required_adversarial_falsifier.v2_required: Every such construction must fail at least one unchanged hard gate; specifically malformed partitions must reduce parse_validity and cannot hide from verdict/evidence denominators.
